search_text: published ZDI-20-495 ZDI-CAN-9376 Intel Wi-Fi Link Driver Netwtw06 Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-04-15 CVE-2020-0558 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-0558 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Intel'] ['Wi-Fi Link Driver'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Intel Wi-Fi Link Driver. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of 802.11 frames. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel. Intel has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Intel Wi-Fi Link Driver Netwtw06 Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Intel Wi-Fi Link Driver. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of 802.11 frames. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel.
